_comment: Code-coverage ratchet baseline for build.ps1 Gate 3. 'overall' is Pester's JaCoCo CoveragePercent over Modules/; 'perModule' is per-module command hit-ratio (same computation the gate uses at runtime, used only to name regressed modules). Raise these numbers in a deliberate commit when build.ps1 prints the 'ratchet: baseline can be raised' hint. See .github/CONTRIBUTING.md. Measured on 1199 passing tests.
